get.description: Retrieves all asset line items for the given account(s).

parameters.name: accountIds
parameters.description: List of accounts

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Specify the sort order and a sort field separated by any of these characters: " ", ",", "(", ")", ";". Sort order is ascending by default

  • Sample input to sort by Quantity field in descending order: `desc Quantity`
  • Sample input to sort by Quantity field in ascending order: `Quantity`

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Add conditional filters in standard URI format to narrow the search results.

parameters.name: filterExpression
parameters.description:
Specifies a logical expression to combine multiple filter conditions, use numbers to reference filter indexes (1-based) with logical operators (AND, OR). Example:

  • "1 AND 2" - Both first and second filters must be satisfied
  • "(1 OR 2) AND 3" - Either first or second filter must be satisfied, and third filter must be satisfied
  • Leave empty to apply all filters with AND logic by default

parameters.name: cartId
parameters.description: The cart's unique identifier

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Specify the page number

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Specify the number of records per page

parameters.name: fetchTopLevelBundlesOnly
parameters.description: Indicates whether only a root-level bundle or standalone asset must be fetched.

parameters.name: productSearchString
parameters.description: Searches against product fields to filter assets.

parameters.name: fetchAttributes
parameters.description: Indicates whether attribute must be fetched.

parameters.name: rootLineItemFilter
parameters.description:
Indicates filters that should be applied only to root line items. 
           <remarks>
           Ensure the `fetchTopLevelBundlesOnly` flag is set to `true` when passing a root filter.
           If not provided, the API will automatically default it to `true`.
           </remarks>
